components.name: Mounting Brackets and Hardware

Solar Cell.name: Silicon
Solar Cell.reasoning: Core semiconductor material enabling photovoltaic energy conversion, absolutely essential in most solar cells defining the technology.

Solar Cell.name: Silver
Solar Cell.reasoning: Used for front contact metallization to collect electric current, industry standard with no widely used substitutes at scale.

Solar Cell.name: Aluminum
Solar Cell.reasoning: Employed for back contacts and framing, provides mechanical support and conductivity, universally used.

Solar Cell.name: Boron
Solar Cell.reasoning: Common p-type dopant for silicon solar cells to create the PN junction, standard material though alternatives like gallium exist.

Solar Cell.name: Phosphorus
Solar Cell.reasoning: N-type dopant creating the opposite side of the PN junction essential for cell function; arsenic is a rare alternative.

Solar Cell.name: Glass
Solar Cell.reasoning: Protective top layer substrates allowing light transmission and mechanical protection, industry standard substrate material.

Solar Cell.name: Silicon dioxide
Solar Cell.reasoning: Forms passivation layers on silicon surfaces, improves efficiency and protects against recombination, common in solar cells.

Junction Box.name: Polyethylene
Junction Box.reasoning: Widely used polymer for insulation and encapsulation within junction boxes due to electrical insulating properties.

Junction Box.name: Copper
Junction Box.reasoning: Primary conductor material for electrical pathways inside the junction box, universally standard in electrical components.

Junction Box.name: Silicon dioxide
Junction Box.reasoning: Used in some electronic components and protective coatings within the junction box, alternatives exist but commonly used.

Junction Box.name: Epoxy resins
Junction Box.reasoning: Used to pot and encapsulate electronic parts protecting against moisture and mechanical stress; common in junction boxes.

Chassis Assembly.name: Aluminum
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Primary structural material providing lightweight strength and corrosion resistance; industry standard for solar panel chassis.

Chassis Assembly.name: Glass
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Used when glass is involved in structural laminated panels or protective layers attached to chassis; alternatives include plastics but glass is standard.

Chassis Assembly.name: Steel Ingots
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Used in some chassis assemblies particularly for structural support; substitution possible with aluminum but steel is typical.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Copper
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Primary conductor metal providing excellent electrical conductivity critical for minimal losses in cables; industry standard.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Polyethylene
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Common insulating outer jacket material providing electrical insulation and environmental protection; widely used polymer.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Aluminum
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Sometimes used as a conductor in cables for cost reduction and weight savings, but less conductive than copper and less common in solar panel cables.

Mounting Brackets And Hardware.name: Aluminum
Mounting Brackets And Hardware.reasoning: Widely used for mounting brackets due to strength, corrosion resistance, and light weight; industry standard material.

Mounting Brackets And Hardware.name: Steel Ingots
Mounting Brackets And Hardware.reasoning: Commonly used for mounting hardware that requires higher structural strength and durability, standard material for screws and brackets.

Mounting Brackets And Hardware.name: Stainless steel
Mounting Brackets And Hardware.reasoning: Used in hardware to provide corrosion resistance especially in outdoor environments, important for longevity of mounting systems.
